description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl class, which is an immutable representation of a delete features command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create instances, set headers, and query command properties.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DeleteFeaturesLiveCommand interface, providing methods for command creation, header modification, and category identification.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to DeleteFeatures.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified Ditto headers set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides an answer builder instance for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command instance.
